Hi! I'm deciding between a few options and money's a bit tight, can you help me choose?Supergoop! AII understand that budget can be a concern when making a purchase. The PLAY Everyday Lotion SPF 50 offers great value, especially with the larger sizes like the 18 fl. oz. option, which is great for families and lasts longer.

LeahJB, a reviewer, mentions that the 18 oz bottle lasts for her family of four for the whole season, making it cost-effective.
Jasmine S. appreciates the value size with a pump for both body and face use.
LeahJBVerified Buyer5.0One coat of this sunscreen before a beach or pool day, and you’re set! No joke. I buy the 18 oz bottle each spring and it lasts for my family of four for the whole season - and we live at the beach. You don’t need much (so it ends up being worth the cost) and it absorbs fast. The scent is great, and I have scent sensitivities! I coat myself and my kids before a boat, beach or pool day, when we’re getting dressed. I feel like that first liquid coat is so good, it reduces the need for reapplication and so you can pick the easy options for re-coats like the spray or stick options. 
PS This is the only review I have ever written. I’ve used this sunscreen for 5+ years and skipped using any last weekend and got scorched. I never get burned when I’ve used Play.
